  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling ideas from briefs or creative direction
  • Use generative AI tools to create unique imagery, animations, environments, and visual sequences
  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content
  • Experience creating modern social-first creative content for startups, agencies, brands, or creators
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail

  • CapCut

  • Sound design and pacing

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of viral short-form content frameworks
  • Experience with 3D or experimental visual workflows
  • Familiarity with creative automation workflows

title: PMO - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender uma multinacional líder global no segmento de bens de consumo e transformação digital, com atuação em projetos estratégicos de tecnologia, inovação e expansão internacional.

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar em iniciativas globais e LATAM relacionadas à transformação digital, omnichannel, AI e implementação de sistemas corporativos , com forte interação entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar na gestão de projetos estratégicos e programas corporativos
  • Garantir acompanhamento de cronograma, escopo, riscos, custos e qualidade
  • Coordenar stakeholders locais e globais
  • Conduzir governança, status reports e fóruns executivos
  • Atuar na integração entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e implementação de sistemas
  • Garantir alinhamento entre times multidisciplinares
  • Atuar de forma hands-on na resolução de temas críticos e acompanhamento das entregas


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como PMO ou em gestão de projetos complexos
  • Vivência com governança, cronogramas multidisciplinares e gestão de stakeholders
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital ou implementação de sistemas
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, PMBOK ou similares )
  • Boa capacidade analítica e organização
  • Inglês avançado e/ou Espanhol fluente dependendo da atuação
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota ou híbrida conforme projeto


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Boa comunicação e interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos
  • Perfil estruturado, proativo e com senso de dono
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes multiculturais e dinâmicos
  • Vivência com SAP, Workday, E-commerce, AI ou projetos LATAM
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em projetos em constante evolução


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Temos oportunidades nos seguintes modelos de atuação:

• No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

• Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido – 3x por semana em São Paulo/SP

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: PMO - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO - brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender uma multinacional líder global no segmento de bens de consumo e transformação digital, com atuação em projetos estratégicos de tecnologia, inovação e expansão internacional.

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar em iniciativas globais e LATAM relacionadas à transformação digital, omnichannel, AI e implementação de sistemas corporativos , com forte interação entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar na gestão de projetos estratégicos e programas corporativos
  • Garantir acompanhamento de cronograma, escopo, riscos, custos e qualidade
  • Coordenar stakeholders locais e globais
  • Conduzir governança, status reports e fóruns executivos
  • Atuar na integração entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e implementação de sistemas
  • Garantir alinhamento entre times multidisciplinares
  • Atuar de forma hands-on na resolução de temas críticos e acompanhamento das entregas


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como PMO ou em gestão de projetos complexos
  • Vivência com governança, cronogramas multidisciplinares e gestão de stakeholders
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital ou implementação de sistemas
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, PMBOK ou similares )
  • Boa capacidade analítica e organização
  • Inglês avançado e/ou Espanhol fluente dependendo da atuação
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota ou híbrida conforme projeto


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Boa comunicação e interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos
  • Perfil estruturado, proativo e com senso de dono
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes multiculturais e dinâmicos
  • Vivência com SAP, Workday, E-commerce, AI ou projetos LATAM
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em projetos em constante evolução


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Temos oportunidades nos seguintes modelos de atuação:

• No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

• Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido – 3x por semana em São Paulo/SP

title: Professor de inglês online
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês online em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A DevSpeak Academy é uma escola especializada no ensino de inglês para profissionais da área de tecnologia. Nosso foco é preparar alunos para se comunicarem com confiança no mercado internacional, em turmas pequenas e com aulas totalmente online.

Estamos em busca de professores(as) de inglês para integrar nosso time! Procuramos profissionais engajados, comunicativos e que saibam se conectar com adultos que trabalham em TI, trazendo para as aulas situações práticas e relevantes para o dia a dia desses alunos.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar e ministrar aulas online para adultos, focando em fluência e comunicação em contextos profissionais.
  • Personalizar o conteúdo conforme as necessidades dos alunos, com foco em temas ligados à área de tecnologia.
  • Preencher e manter atualizadas as planilhas de presença e conteúdos ministrados.
  • Disponibilizar semanalmente os materiais e gravações no Google Classroom, seguindo a metodologia da escola.
  • Incentivar a participação e engajamento dos alunos, criando um ambiente colaborativo e motivador.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões pedagógicas para melhoria contínua.


Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Experiência como professor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período da noite (18h–22h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Perfil comunicativo e afinidade para trabalhar com profissionais da área de TI.
  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos.
  • Possuir computador para ministrar as aulas.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Disponibilidade no período da manhã (7h-9h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Conhecimento em Google Meet e Google Classroom.
  • Experiência com ensino para profissionais de TI.
  • Certificações em ensino de inglês (TEFL, CELTA ou equivalentes).


Contratação

  • Regime PJ .
  • Horários fixos (aulas no início da manhã e/ou à noite), com flexibilidade para conciliar com a disponibilidade do professor.
  • Turmas pequenas, que permitem um acompanhamento próximo e personalizado.


Se você tem paixão por ensinar e quer fazer parte de uma escola que conecta inglês e tecnologia, envie seu CV.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer (2y experience w/ Snowflake mandatory) - Relocation to Portugal em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.



Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET + React)
description:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento full stack, contribuindo também com frontend componentizado (React, Vue ou similares)
  • Construir e manter integrações com plataformas externas (e-commerce, marketplaces e parceiros logísticos), utilizando REST, GraphQL e OAuth 2.0

  • Investigar incidentes críticos, realizar troubleshooting avançado e atuar na causa raiz
  • Garantir observabilidade dos sistemas (APM, logs estruturados e métricas) para suporte à operação
  • Contribuir ativamente com decisões de arquitetura, avaliando trade-offs técnicos e impactos no negócio
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e integração) como parte do desenvolvimento
  • Participar de code reviews, promovendo qualidade, padrões e evolução técnica do time
  • Documentar APIs e fluxos técnicos (OpenAPI/Swagger, diagramas, changelogs)
Requisitos:
  • Forte experiência com .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento full stack (React, Vue ou similares).
  • Sólida experiência em design e consumo de APIs RESTful
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e modelagem de dados
  • Conhecimento prático em mensageria e sistemas assíncronos (ex: SQS, RabbitMQ ou similares)
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (xUnit, Moq ou similares)
  • Vivência com cloud (preferencialmente AWS: S3, SQS, Lambda ou equivalentes)
  • Experiência com containers (Docker)
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, New Relic ou similares)
  • Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e práticas de DevOps
  • Domínio de Git e estratégias de versionamento
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia
  • Visão crítica sobre arquitetura e qualidade de código
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e não técnicos
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas complexos
  • Ownership sobre o que desenvolve
Diferenciais:
  • Experiência aplicando IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex: copilots, code assistants, automação de testes, análise de logs)
  • Experiência com Kubernetes
  • Experiência com GraphQL
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura distribuída e microsserviços
  • Experiência com práticas como Clean Architecture, SOLID ou DDD
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta escala ou missão crítica
  • Sobre a vaga:
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Ambiente internacional.

description:

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

  • Plan and coordinate disaster recovery (DR) testing activities across enterprise applications and services
  • Develop and execute structured DR test scenarios aligned with predefined recovery patterns
  • Produce detailed post-test reports, including outcomes, gaps, and recommendations for improvement

  • Experience coordinating and executing testing activities in enterprise IT environments
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for tracking incidents and action items
  • Ability to analyze test results and produce clear, actionable reports
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing cycles and priorities
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with effective collaboration skills
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Problem-solving mindset with focus on risk reduction and process improvement


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• International team environment

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Investimentos WS B2B/B2B2C em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empreenda como Consultor Independente com a Revert - B2B/B2B2C


Você buscou ser livre.

Mas a operação te prendeu de novo.

Relatório pra um cliente.

Conciliação de outro.

Extrato que não bate.

E-mail cobrando posição.


No fim, você virou consultor pra passar mais tempo com cliente…

e está passando mais tempo com planilha.


O que é a Revert


A Revert é uma empresa de tecnologia baseada em serviços, criando um ecossistema de consultorias de investimentos independente, construída para tirar o peso da operação do consultor.


Aqui, a lógica é simples:

enquanto você está com o cliente, a operação roda por trás.

  • Consolidação de carteira automática
  • Suporte operacional completo
  • Uso de tecnologia e IA para ganho de escala
  • Atendimento em múltiplas instituições (sem ficar preso a uma plataforma)

Não é software.

É o serviço funcionando por você.


Para quem é

Essa oportunidade é para quem:

  • Já tem carteira de clientes no mundo consultoria
  • Quer parar de perder tempo com operacional
  • Busca mais tempo de qualidade com o cliente
  • Quer escalar sua atuação como consultor independente


⚠️ Importante

Estamos no início e sendo seletivos com nossos parceitos.

Fazemos poucas parcerias — com quem realmente quer construir algo grande.


Interessou?

  • Se fez sentido, vamos conversar.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: Analista de Implantação de ERP – Módulos Fiscal/Contábil ou Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Implantação de ERP – Módulos Fiscal/Contábil ou Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.


Requisitos:


  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:


  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.
  • Conhecimento Fiscal: ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, FCP, IPI, FUNRURAL, Sped Fiscal, Sped Contribuições, EFD REINF, NCM, CEST, CST, CFOP, retenções na fonte sobre serviços tomados/prestados (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS).
  • Conhecimento Supply Chain: Rotina de Compras, Pricing (Precificação de Produtos e Margem Líquida), Recebimento de Mercadorias, Conhecimento Básico da Tributação (NCM, IPI, ICMS, PIS), Processos no Varejo.



Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Experiência com Implantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;
  • Experiência com Varejo;
  • Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;
  • Experiência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Visão analítica para apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

  • Curate real-world research corpora — academic papers, case studies, technical reports — and design questions that require comprehensive analysis
  • Write structured ground-truth oracles (JSON) with specific, verifiable answers that prove the agent actually read the source material
  • Design LLM judge prompts that evaluate agent output field-by-field against the oracle
  • Create decomposition guides that split research across multiple parallel sub-agents (one per document, one per domain, then synthesis)


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of research experience (academic or industry) in any scientific domain
  • Strong reading comprehension with ability to extract structured data from unstructured text
  • Experience with JSON and data structures, including schema design and output validation

  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with systematic reviews, meta-analyses, or large-scale literature surveys
  • Familiarity with medical, legal, or scientific document analysis
  • Experience with NLP or information extraction tasks
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation and benchmarking (e.g., MMLU, GPQA, SimpleQA)
  • Experience curating datasets for AI evaluation


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

Offer Details:

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.


Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.


Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

  • Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM.
  • Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM.
  • May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM.

description:

Job Title: Web Development Manager


About Client Company:

Our client company is a fast-growing US-based marketing agency focused on building high-performing digital experiences that drive measurable business growth for clients. We cover graphic designs, web designs, web development, and many other services for clients across a wide range of industries.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Web Development Manager to lead our web team, oversee client web projects, and improve the overall quality and conversion performance of the websites we build.


This is not just a developer role. We are looking for someone who can combine technical expertise, leadership, project management, CRO thinking, and strong client communication skills.


Work Schedule: Flexible 20-30 hours/week to start and transition to full-time very quickly. US Hours.


What You’ll Be Responsible For

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor the web development team
  • Assign projects based on team strengths and workload capacity
  • Review work to ensure high-quality standards across all projects
  • Support team growth, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Help improve internal web development processes and workflows

Web Development & CRO

  • Build and optimize websites using Shopify, WordPress, Framer, and Webflow
  • Conduct Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) audits to improve website performance
  • Identify website issues that negatively impact conversions and user experience
  • Improve site structure, speed, responsiveness, and usability
  • Support troubleshooting and technical problem-solving on complex projects

Project Management

  • Manage multiple web projects simultaneously from kickoff to launch
  • Create timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure projects are delivered on time
  • Coordinate with designers, marketers, copywriters, and developers
  • Maintain organized project documentation and communication

Client Communication

  • Lead client meetings for website projects
  • Explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical clients
  • Provide project updates and manage client expectations professionally
  • Build strong long-term relationships through excellent customer service

AI & Innovation

  • Use modern AI tools such as Lovable, Google Stitch, and other AI-assisted web development platforms
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency using AI workflows
  • Stay updated on emerging AI tools and web development trends
  • Help implement scalable systems and processes using AI technology


Requirements

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on web development experience
  • Strong experience with: Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, and Framer.
  • Strong understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience identifying conversion bottlenecks and improving website performance
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Understanding of responsive design and mobile optimization
  • Experience with website speed optimization and SEO best practices
  • Familiarity with tracking setup including pixels, Google Tag Manager, and analytics tools


Leadership & Communication

  • Previous experience leading or mentoring developers
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Comfortable working directly with clients and presenting solutions


Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience working in a marketing agency environment
  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows
  • Familiarity with UX/UI best practices
  • Experience improving operational efficiency within a web team

title: Remote Computer Science Expert - 79004
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Computer Science Expert - 79004 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Job Overview:

We are looking for PhD-level computer science experts to help fine-tune and evaluate large language models, including systems similar to ChatGPT. The role focuses on designing challenging, conceptual computer science problems that test advanced AI reasoning across topics such as algorithms, systems design, cybersecurity, theory, databases, networks, and other undergraduate to PhD-level computer science domains.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design advanced computer science problems that test AI model performance across conceptual and reasoning-heavy topics, including systems design, algorithms, cybersecurity, and other advanced CS areas.
  • Develop clear, step-by-step reference solutions with rigorous logic, well-structured explanations, and defensible reasoning.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for correctness, reasoning quality, completeness, clarity, and alignment with the intended problem requirements.
  • Identify flaws, gaps, edge cases, and near-miss reasoning patterns in AI outputs.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine benchmarks across undergraduate, graduate, and PhD-level computer science topics.
  • Provide structured feedback to improve problem quality, benchmark reliability, and model evaluation standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • PhD, completed or pursuing, in Computer Science or a closely related field.
  • Strong computer science reasoning and problem-solving skills across advanced domains.
  • Ability to design challenging conceptual problems that require deep understanding rather than straightforward recall or coding.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly and logically.
  • Strong attention to detail in evaluating reasoning, assumptions, definitions, edge cases, and solution validity.
  • Ability to provide structured, high-quality feedback on AI-generated responses.
  • No prior AI experience required.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them.   • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.

  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Basis Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis)
  • Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade)
  • Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance
  • Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias
  • Gestão de backup & recovery
  • Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery
  • Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO)
  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados
  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças
  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade
  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Professor de inglês
description:

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.
